2608.12274.title: A Neighborhood Attention Transformer Network for Enhanced 3D Segmentation of the Left Anterior Descending Artery
2608.12274.paper_summary: Background: Accurate segmentation of the Left Anterior Descending (LAD) artery in 3D free-breathing, non-contrast CT is critical for cardiac dose sparing in thoracic radiotherapy. The LAD is extremely small, has poor soft-tissue contrast, and varies substantially across patients; even manual contours show limited inter-observer agreement, underscoring the ambiguity of the vessel boundaries. Purpose: To develop a transformer-based framework that improves LAD delineation in low-contrast, imbalanced CT through local-global context modeling and uncertainty-guided optimization. Methods: We propose NA-UNETR, a 3D transformer-based segmentation model whose Neighborhood Attention (NA) and Dilated NA (DiNA) blocks jointly capture fine structural detail and long-range context. Given the scarcity of annotated LAD data, the model is pretrained on 1,000 CTA volumes of general coronary anatomy and fine-tuned with LoRA-based parameter-efficient adaptation on 20 free-breathing institutional CT scans. A composite Dice-Focal and Hausdorff loss, dynamically balanced via homoscedastic uncertainty, improves overlap and boundary accuracy. Results: NA-UNETR reached 45.64% Dice, 38.16 mm HD95, and 10.01 mm ASD, improving Dice by 3.10 percentage points over nnU-Net and reducing HD95 by 2.96 mm relative to Swin UNETR, with the strongest boundary accuracy among all models and improved centerline stability. On ImageCAS it achieved 79.49% Dice, 8.89 mm HD95, and 1.02 mm ASD. Ablations confirmed that residual blocks, variable kernels, and uncertainty-weighted loss each contributed. Conclusions: NA-UNETR balances local precision and global context for thin, low-contrast LAD structures, offering a computationally efficient framework for substructure-level cardiac segmentation in radiotherapy planning.
2608.12274.paper_summary_zh: 背景：在三維自由呼吸、無對比劑的CT中準確分割左前降支（LAD）動脈對於胸部放射治療中的心臟劑量保護至關重要。LAD非常小，軟組織對比度差，並且在患者之間變化很大；即使是手動輪廓也顯示出有限的觀察者間一致性，突顯了血管邊界的模糊性。目的：開發一種基於Transformer的框架，通過局部-全局上下文建模和不確定性引導的優化來改善低對比度、不平衡CT中的LAD描繪。方法：我們提出NA-UNETR，一種基於3DTransformer的分割模型，其鄰域注意力（NA）和擴張NA（DiNA）模塊共同捕捉細微的結構細節和長距離上下文。考慮到標註LAD數據的稀缺，該模型在1,000個一般冠狀動脈解剖的CTA體積上進行預訓練，並在20個自由呼吸的機構CT掃描上進行基於LoRA的參數高效適應的微調。通過均質不確定性動態平衡的綜合Dice-Focal和Hausdorff損失，提高了重疊度和邊界準確性。結果：NA-UNETR達到了45.64%的Dice，38.16 mm的HD95，和10.01 mm的ASD，較nnU-Net提高了3.10個百分點的Dice，並相對於Swin UNETR減少了2.96 mm的HD95，擁有所有模型中最強的邊界準確性和改善的中心線穩定性。在ImageCAS上，它達到了79.49%的Dice，8.89 mm的HD95，和1.02 mm的ASD。消融實驗確認殘差塊、變量核和不確定性加權損失各自都有貢獻。結論：NA-UNETR平衡了薄而低對比度的LAD結構的局部精度和全局上下文，為放射治療計劃中的子結構級心臟分割提供了一個計算高效的框架。
